title: 1 · Hiragana: reading Japanese sounds
blurb: Read the basic hiragana letters, the two sound marks, and the particles は, を and へ.

title: 2 · Small letters, long vowels and pitch
blurb: Read small ゃ ゅ ょ and っ, hold long vowels for two beats, and hear pitch differences.

title: 3 · Katakana: loanwords and names
blurb: Read katakana loanwords and names, with ー for long vowels and the extra sounds for foreign words.

title: 4 · X は Y です: introducing yourself
blurb: Introduce yourself, say what you are and are not, and ask simple questions politely.

title: 5 · これ・それ・あれ: this and that
blurb: Point at things and places near you, near the listener or far away, and ask for them in a shop.

title: 6 · Numbers, prices and the time
blurb: Say numbers up to 99,999, ask and give prices in yen, and tell the time.

title: 7 · の and も: my, your, and "too"
blurb: Say whose something is with の, add "too" with も, and talk about your family and someone else's.

title: 8 · Verbs in the ます form
blurb: Say what you do and don't do with polite verbs, and put the verb at the end of the sentence.

title: 9 · Particles を・に・で・へ
blurb: Say what you act on, where you go, when, where you do something and how, with を, に, へ and で.

title: 10 · あります / います: there is
blurb: Say what is where, for things and for people and animals, with on, under, next to and more.

title: 11 · Past: でした・ました
blurb: Say what you did, what you didn't do, and what something was, with ました, ませんでした and でした.

title: 12 · ませんか・ましょう: inviting
blurb: Invite someone, suggest a plan, offer help, and say yes or a polite no.

title: 13 · First kanji: numbers, days, people
blurb: Read 30 everyday kanji words: numbers, yen, the days of the week, times, people and Japan.

title: 14 · い and な adjectives
blurb: Describe things now and in the past, say what they aren't, and put adjectives before nouns.

title: 15 · すき・きらい: likes and dislikes
blurb: Say what you like, love and dislike, what people are good or bad at, and ask what kind of things someone likes.

title: 16 · Counting things: ひとつ, にまい, さんぼん
blurb: Order and count things and people with the right counter, and put the number in the right place.

title: 17 · The て form: and then
blurb: Make the て form of any verb and use it to string actions and descriptions together.

title: 18 · てください・てもいいですか・てはいけません
blurb: Ask people to do things, ask for permission, and understand what you must not do.

title: 19 · ている: doing now, and states
blurb: Say what people are doing right now, and talk about states such as being married, living somewhere or knowing someone.

title: 20 · Short forms and casual speech
blurb: Talk casually with friends in short forms, and know when to stay with です and ます.

title: 21 · とおもいます・といっていました: opinions and reports
blurb: Say what you think and pass on what someone said, with と おもいます and と いって いました.

title: 22 · Describing people and things with verbs
blurb: Describe a person or thing with a whole clause, like "the book I bought yesterday", using past short forms.

title: 23 · Comparing: より・いちばん
blurb: Compare two things with より, ask "which one?" with どちら, and say "the most" with いちばん.

title: 24 · つもり・なる: plans and changes
blurb: Talk about your plans with つもりです, and about changes (get cold, become a teacher) with なります.

title: 25 · たい: want to
blurb: Say what you want to do (and don't), what you want to have, and invite people without asking what they want.

title: 26 · たことがあります: experiences
blurb: Say what you have and haven't done before, and ask "Have you ever…?"

title: 27 · んです・ので: explaining
blurb: Explain a situation with んです, ask "What's wrong?", and give a reason politely with ので.

title: 28 · なければいけません・ほうがいい
blurb: Say what you must do and don't have to do, and give advice with ほうが いいです.
